name: Anathematize
subtitle: didn't see that coming!
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character loses 5 strength. Draw a card.
flavor: Curiously enough, the only thing that went through his mind as he was pulled up was "Oh no, not again."
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating; card prints COST –/EFFECT –. No artist credit in footer.

name: Arcane Research
subtitle: oh, my missing aggie!
rules: Search your deck for up to 4 tactics. Put them into your discard pile.
flavor: I told him we could play for keepsies, but I didn't think he'd eat them.

name: Brainbath
subtitle: relaxing and revitalizing for a fresher, younger you
rules: Draw 2 cards. Put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck. -- RECUR – [O][O] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 4. Remove this card from the game. -- EFFECT – Your opponent discards a card. Draw a card.
notes: Card prints 'Your opponent discards a card'; catalog says 'An opponent' (updated templating, same play in 2-player). No artist credit in footer.

name: Confounding Conjurer
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Lim Hang Kwong
rules: COST – You may pick a character. -- When this card enters play, if you picked a character as part of its cost, put that character into its owner's hand.
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating; card prints COST –. Artist Series watermark in text box; artist named only in subtitle (Lim Hang Kwong), not footer.

name: Cryptic Athenaeum
subtitle: do you have "Bartholomew and the Oobleck"...?
rules: UNIQUE CRYPTIC ATHENAEUM -- [O][O][O] – At the start of your turn, you may draw a card. If you do, your opponent may draw a card. -- [O][O][O][O][O] – At the start of your turn, your opponent discards a card. -- [O][O][O][O][O][O][O] – At the start of your turn, you may pick a character. If you do, put it into its owner's hand.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent'; catalog 'an opponent' (updated templating).

name: Day of the Tentacle
subtitle: we may not live to see yesterday
rules: Look at your opponent's hand and choose a non-resource card in it. Put it into play under your opponent's control as a face-down resource.
flavor: What possible harm could one insane, mutant tentacle do?
notes: Card prints 'your opponent'; catalog 'an opponent' / 'that opponent' (updated templating).

name: Defiler of Innocence
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Guang Yu
rules: CORRUPT -- COST – Pay 2. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains COVERT. -- DEFILE -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Look at your opponent's hand and choose a character in it. Your opponent discards that character.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent'; catalog 'an opponent' / 'that player' (updated templating). Artist Series watermark; artist named only in subtitle (Guang Yu).

name: Domain of Depravity
subtitle: where's waldo now?
rules: At the start of your turn, you may pick a character. If you do, put a token on it. -- All characters lose 1 strength, 1 life, and 1 speed for each token on them.
flavor: "These cutaneous lichens will be delicious in my soup!"

name: Encumber
subtitle: he should have brought crackers for everyone
rules: COST – Pick a character or location. -- EFFECT – Put the character or location into its owner's hand. -- RECUR – [O] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 2. Remove this card from the game. -- EFFECT – Look at your opponent's hand and choose a non-resource card in it. Your opponent discards that card.
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating; card prints 'Your opponent' where catalog says 'An opponent'/'That opponent'.

name: Ensorcelled Familiar
subtitle: it's helpful, but the stench is kinda crazy-making
rules: When this card enters play, you may search your deck for a tactic and reveal it. If you do, put it into your hand. -- RECUR – [O][O][O] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 2. Remove this card from the game. Pick a tactic in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the tactic into your hand.

name: Essence of Obsession
subtitle: filled with bombs and/or keys
rules: Choose one of the following as this card's rules text: -- OPTION 1 -- Your opponent discards a card. -- OPTION 2 -- COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains COVERT. -- OPTION 3 -- COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character loses 2 strength.
notes: Card prints 'Your opponent'; catalog 'An opponent'. Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating for options 2/3.

name: Evanesce
subtitle: you're melting! you're melting! what a world!
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Put the character into its owner's hand. -- FLIP UP – 1 [O][O]
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating; card prints COST –.

name: Fiendish Fez
subtitle: or perhaps you'd prefer our beastly beanie?
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character loses 2 strength and cannot attack. -- MOVE -- COST – Use this only not during a battle. Pay 3. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character.
notes: Item badges printed -2 STR, -0 LIFE, -0 SPD.

name: Flagitious Denunciator
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Teck Chin
rules: COVERT -- DENOUNCE -- COST – Pay 2. Pick a character. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Put the character into its owner's hand. Look at your opponent's hand and choose a character in it. Your opponent discards that character.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent'; catalog 'an opponent' / 'that player'. Artist Series watermark; artist named only in subtitle (Teck Chin).

name: Forbidden Knowledge
subtitle: i never knew thrush-bugs could be so filthy
rules: You may look at your opponent's hand, the top card of their deck, and their face-down resources. Draw a card. -- FLIP UP – 0 [O][O]
notes: Card prints 'your opponent's hand'; catalog 'an opponent's hand'.

name: Foul Diviner
subtitle: i hear he's actually a pretty nice guy
rules: COST – Remove a tactic in your discard pile from the game.
flavor: "Your blood will paint the way to the future."
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating; card prints COST –.

name: High-Priest of Thabbash
subtitle: as ruthless as he is compromising
rules: UNIQUE GLOAMSPIKE -- NEGATE -- COST – Pay 2. Deplete this card. Discard a card. Pick a card being played of the same type as the discarded card. -- EFFECT – Terminate the card being played.
flavor: "Something something something daaark siiide. Something something something compleeete."
notes: Card prints 'being played'; catalog says 'being deployed' (updated terminology, same play).

name: Horrendous Behemoth
subtitle: just relax and go with it, man
rules: While this card is in a battle, characters in the opposing party lose 1 strength and 1 speed.
flavor: In his belly you will find a new definition of pain and suffering as you are slowly digested over a thousand years.

name: Horrifying Brain-Monkey
subtitle: i have a mind to kick your ass
rules: SLOBBER -- COST – Pay 4. Destroy this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Destroy the character if it has X strength or less, where X is the number of [O] you control.
flavor: "Horrifying brain-monkey, I choose you!"

name: Inhibit
subtitle: i will love him and hug him and name him George
rules: COST – Pick a non-resource card. -- EFFECT – Until the start of your next turn, treat the card as though it has no rules text. Draw a card.
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating; card prints COST –.

name: Intellectual Reliquary
subtitle: i'm always changing my mind
rules: IMBIBE -- COST – Pay 1. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may choose a tactic among them and reveal it. If you do, put it into your hand. Put the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order.
flavor: "...and this is the brain where I keep my mad ninja skillz."
notes: No stat badges printed on this item.

name: Lingamite Torture Monk
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Guang Yu
rules: TORTURE -- COST – Pick a character you own. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Put the character into its owner's hand. -- RECUR – [O][O] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 2. Remove this card from the game. Pick a character you own. -- EFFECT – Put the character into its owner's hand.
notes: Artist Series watermark; artist named only in subtitle (Guang Yu).

name: Living God of Thabbash
subtitle: that is god. respect accordingly.
rules: When a character you control leaves play, your opponent discards a card. -- HIGHER CALLING -- COST – Pay 2. Pick a character you control. -- EFFECT – Put the character into its owner's hand.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent'; catalog 'an opponent'.

name: Mesmerizing Enchantress
subtitle: disarmingly charming
rules: COST – You may pick 4 or fewer characters. -- When this card enters play, if you picked characters as part of its cost, they cannot attack until the start of your next turn.
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating; card prints COST –.

name: Mirthless Altar
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Guang Yu
rules: At the start of each player's turn, you may pick a character. If you do, it loses 1 strength this turn.
notes: Artist Series watermark; artist named only in subtitle (Guang Yu).

name: Nefarious Horror
subtitle: watching and waiting
rules: COVERT -- While your opponent controls more characters than you, this card gains 2 strength, 2 life, and loses COVERT.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent'; catalog 'an opponent'.

name: Neurosis
rules: This card provides – [O][O] -- When this card enters play, your faction loses 1 influence.
notes: Rotated (landscape) resource layout. Sentence order differs from catalog (catalog lists the enters-play influence loss first, PROVIDES second); same play.

name: Obscene Communion
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Ben Ang
rules: At the start of each player's turn, that player chooses one of the following: -- OPTION 1 – Both players draw a card. Both players put a card from their hand on the bottom of their deck. -- OPTION 2 – Both players put a resource they control into its owner's hand. Both players may play a resource. -- OPTION 3 – Both players discard a card. -- OPTION 4 – Both players put a card from their hand on the top of their deck.
notes: Card prints 'Both players'; catalog 'Each player' (updated templating, same play). Artist Series watermark (faint); artist named only in subtitle (Ben Ang). No stat badges.

name: Obscure
subtitle: the shroud of invisibility is worth the vomitous stench
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains COVERT. -- FLIP UP – 2 [O]
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating; card prints COST –.

name: Obsession
notes: Rotated (landscape) staple resource, text box empty. Where rarity/collector number normally appears the bubble reads 'STAPLE' only; no collector number.

name: Perturbatious Warlock
subtitle: ting-tang wadda-wadda bing-bang
rules: When this card enters play, your opponent puts a card from their hand on the top of their deck.
flavor: "I'm sorry but I still can't love you. I don't want to get hurt again."
notes: Card prints 'your opponent'; catalog 'an opponent'.

name: Reality Shift
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Henry Gunawan
rules: X is the total numeric cost of all non-resource cards you control. Put those cards into their owner's hand. You may play any number of cards for free with total numeric cost X or less. (You still need to meet their threshold and satisfy their extra costs.)
flavor: I reject your reality and substitute my own.
notes: Card prints 'play any number of cards'; catalog says 'deploy' (updated terminology). Catalog typo 'owners's hand'. Artist Series watermark; artist named only in subtitle (Henry Gunawan).

name: Rouse
subtitle: wise from your gwabe!
rules: COST – Pick a tactic in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the tactic on the top of your deck. -- RECUR – [O][O][O] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 1. Remove this card from the game. Pick a tactic in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the tactic on the top of your deck.
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating; card prints COST –.

name: Sequestered Hellion
subtitle: not very frightening
rules: COVERT -- FLIP UP – 7 [O][O]
flavor: ...until it EATS you! Rarrrrr!

name: Shrouded Demon
subtitle: it grabs them then eats their heads
rules: COVERT -- [O][O][O] – This card gains 2 life.
flavor: Except on Tuesdays, when it takes them bowling.

name: Sin Against Nature
subtitle: i should not exist
rules: When this card enters play, pick a resource you control. Put it into its owner's hand. (You may pick face-down resources.)
flavor: "Every moment I live is agony! Bleaurgghhhh!"

name: Stupidify
subtitle: when i snap my fingers you will be...stupid!
rules: Your opponent discards 2 cards. -- RECUR – [O] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 2. Remove this card from the game. -- EFFECT – Your opponent discards a card.
notes: Card prints 'Your opponent'; catalog 'An opponent'.

name: Thabbashite Haruspex
subtitle: your future is looking brown and veiny
rules: When this card enters or leaves play, you may draw a card. If you do, put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: ...and it doesn't smell very good, either.

name: Thabbashite Wizard
subtitle: i love a good potions book and a bodice ripper
rules: When this card enters play, both players may draw up to 2 cards.
flavor: "The philosopher's draught must be cured for three fortnights with a jewel of amber and the bile of a green tree-hen. His strong manly hands probed every crevice of her silken femininity, their undulating bodies writhing in sensual rhythm, as he thrust his purple-headed warrior into her quivering mound of love pudding."
notes: Card prints 'both players'; catalog 'each player' (updated templating, same play).

name: The Abominable Hamster
subtitle: unholy fiend shat from the bowels of death
rules: COVERT -- [O][O][O][O][O] – This card gains 2 strength.
flavor: Though Death's publicist has since denied the entire incident.

name: Unimportant Wizard
subtitle: he was known as "the boy who was"
rules: FLIP UP – 0 [O]
flavor: No one was very impressed.

name: Virulent Dogmatist
subtitle: BLARG!!!
rules: BERATE -- COST – Pay 2. Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character loses 2 strength or 1 speed.
flavor: "Shame on you youngsters an' your saggy collars!"

name: Wand of Possession
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Zi Jian
rules: POSSESS -- COST – Pay 2. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Put a Micromajig token with COVERT into play.
flavor: No, they don't gain the "evil" subtype.
notes: Italic line 'No, they don't gain the "evil" subtype.' is a rules-flavored joke (not in parentheses) so recorded as flavor; it is not part of the catalog text. Artist Series watermark; artist named only in subtitle (Zi Jian). Art mimics a retro FPS HUD (90% HEALTH / 85% ARMOR / 31 AMMO); that is art, not card text. No stat badges.

name: Wanton Wizard
subtitle: sometimes i can't control my groin
rules: When this card enters play, you may pick a tactic in your discard pile. If you do, put it into play as a face-down resource under your control.
flavor: "Oh, Clem! You randy old cad!"

name: Wrinkly Rabbit
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Patrick Meehan
rules: COVERT -- This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each [O] you control.
flavor: Expands up to 8 times!
notes: Artist Series watermark; artist named only in subtitle (Patrick Meehan).

name: Architectural Restitution
subtitle: it's all good, we had a spare
rules: COST – Play this only while your opponent is attacking. Pick a location in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the location into play under your control. Change the target of your opponent's attack to the location. -- FLIP UP – 2 [G][G]
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating, 'Deploy this only' (card prints 'Play this only') and 'an opponent' (card prints 'your opponent'); same play.

name: Auspicious Tax
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Silvia Gunarso
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character's controller must pay 3 to attack with it.
notes: Artist Series watermark; artist named only in subtitle (Silvia Gunarso). No stat badges.
